use default

use ITEM = (name: string, weight: int, value: int)

best_value(items: List[ITEM], limit: int) -> List[List[int]] is
    let table = LIST(items.count + 1)

    for _ in 0::items.count do
        let row = LIST(limit + 1)

        for _ in 0::limit do
            row.add(0)
        od

        table.add(row)
    od

    for at in 0..items.count do
        let item = items[at]

        for capacity in 0::limit do
            let without = table[at][capacity]

            table[at + 1][capacity] =
                if item.weight > capacity then
                    without
                else
                    let taken = table[at][capacity - item.weight] + item.value

                    if taken > without then taken else without fi
                fi
        od
    od

    return table
si

packed(items: List[ITEM], limit: int) -> List[ITEM] is
    let table = best_value(items, limit)
    let chosen = LIST()

    let at mut = items.count
    let capacity mut = limit

    while at > 0 do
        if table[at][capacity] != table[at - 1][capacity] then
            let item = items[at - 1]

            chosen.add(item)

            capacity = capacity - item.weight
        fi

        at = at - 1
    od

    chosen.reverse()

    return chosen
si
